posts.caption:
Same necklace. Five different fabrics.

Watch the outfit change — chunky rib knit, liquid silk, crisp linen, brushed wool, fine rib — while the gold coin pendant stays locked on her neck. Same pose. Same product. Only the cloth grammar moves.

This is how I'd actually test a piece before I buy: not one static mirror shot… five material reads on one body line.

If you've ever wondered whether your necklace reads on knit vs silk vs linen — save this.
